defects.label: Under-extrusion
defects.description: Gaps between lines, thin or missing walls, porous or weak top surfaces, visible infill through skin.

defects.label: Over-extrusion
defects.description: Blobby, bulging or rough walls, ridges on top surfaces, dimensions larger than intended, elephant-like bulges on walls.

defects.label: Stringing
defects.description: Thin hair-like strands or webs of filament between separate parts or across travel gaps.

defects.label: Sagging bridges
defects.description: Lines spanning unsupported gaps droop, sag, break or curl downwards under a bridge.

defects.label: Curling overhangs
defects.description: Edges of angled overhangs curl upwards, look rough or drooped on the underside.

defects.label: Layer separation
defects.description: Cracks or gaps between layers; layers split apart or delaminate.

defects.label: Blobs / zits
defects.description: Small zits, blobs or pimples of plastic on the surface of walls.

defects.label: Warping / detachment
defects.description: Corners or edges lifted from the bed, bottom not flat, part detached during the print.

defects.label: First layer
defects.description: First layer problems: lines not fused, gaps, rough or squished bottom, poor adhesion, uneven bottom surface.

defects.label: Layer shift
defects.description: Layers abruptly offset horizontally relative to the ones below, a step in the part.

defects.label: Spaghetti / failed print
defects.description: A tangle of loose extruded filament instead of the part; the print failed and continued in mid-air.

defects.label: No defect
defects.description: The part looks correct; no defect of the classes above is visible.

defects.label: Outside the taxonomy
defects.description: A defect is visible but it does not fit any class above.

severity.2: clearly visible: the part works but would be reprinted for a customer
severity.3: severe: the part must be discarded
